policies.title: Saudi ordinary passports: Uzbekistan visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Uzbekistan's live government eVisa dataset assigns Saudi Arabia status 2, defined by the same service as visa-free entry for up to 30 days.
conditions: The live selector status defines a maximum visa-free stay of 30 days.
An official presidential statement separately confirms the introduction of visa-free entry for Saudi citizens; work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.
